verdict.rationale: First-party support docs describe a dedicated ASC 718 Stock Option Expense Report workflow that outputs an Excel (.xlsx) file of ASC 718 report calculations. The platform organizes the inputs (grant types, vesting schedules, plan details), and ASC 718 reporting is included in the Growth plan. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the output is audit-ready or accepted by auditors (e.g., audit trail, valuation-assumption disclosures, auditor-facing formats), and independent or hands-on corroboration; the feature is also gated to the Growth plan.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can produce ASC 718 stock-based compensation expense reports my accountants can hand to auditors

citations.quote: At the completion of this workflow, the platform will generate an Excel file (.xlsx) with ASC 718 report calculations.
We organize everything you may need to create ASC 718 reports, including grant types, vesting schedules and Stock Incentive Plan details.
move to our Growth plan with 409A valuations and ASC 718 reporting and more
